description: A-share top-N movers from the live snapshot (or a past trading day via `date`). Sort keys: `pct` / `pct_asc` / `speed` / `amount` / `turnover` / `total_mv` / `main_net_in` / `main_net_in_asc`; rows with a null sort value land last in both directions. Downloads the full ~3 MB snapshot and ranks client-side — `scan` with `sort` + `limit` ranks server-side and is cheaper. Empty with a `note` during 09:00-09:14. Each row carries `industry` and `top_concept`; both are often missing — coverage, not failure (`top_concept` a subset of A-shares; `industry` excludes `BSE:*`), and `top_concept` is not the limit-up `leading_concept`, which is not served here. Live rows also expose `top_base_concept` `{id,name,kind:base,pct_change}` and `top_concept_status` / `top_base_concept_status` (ready, no_membership, no_snapshot, unavailable). The two layers rank independently; use kind=base for base detail. Historical rows carry neither current theme field nor their statuses. The snapshot includes ETFs: pass `security_type=stock` for a stock-only `amount` board. Historical `date` boards sort only by `pct` / `pct_asc` / `amount` / `turnover`, carry no `top_concept`, and cannot combine `concept_id`.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

concept_id.description: Rank inside one concept / industry instead of the whole market. Filtering happens server-side before ranking, so this is the concept's own leaderboard rather than the market top-N intersected with it. An unknown / inactive / wrong-dimension id returns 404. Get ids from `concepts_list` or `concepts_of`.

concept_kind.description: Dimension of `concept_id`: concept (themes, default) or industry (Shenwan). Ignored alone.

date.description: Past A-share trading day (YYYY-MM-DD) to rank instead of the live snapshot — that day's daily bars. Omit for today. Only pct / pct_asc / amount / turnover sort historically; concept_id cannot be combined.

exchange.description: Narrow to one exchange: SSE / SZSE / BSE

include.description: active = 排除 ST/退市（默认）; all = 全集（含 ST + 退市 + 未知 status）

security_type.description: stock = 只看股票 / etf = 只看 ETF / all（默认）= 两者都要。成交额榜（sort=amount）不传 stock 会被货币 / 短融 ETF 占住头部。服务端在 top-N 截断前过滤。

sort.description: Sort field: pct / pct_asc / speed / amount / turnover / total_mv / main_net_in (主力净流入榜) / main_net_in_asc (净流出榜)

name: market_movers
